subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: Should this automerge E2E harness consume a repository-controlled OpenClaw image, or should CI build the base from the checked-in `Dockerfile.base` rather than trust the external Docker Hub publisher?
rationale: The correct fix depends on the repository's acceptable supply-chain ownership and publishing model; preserving the external image is a policy choice, not a mechanical test repair.

options.title: Publish an OpenClaw-controlled base image
options.body: Build and publish the base from the checked-in Dockerfile under an OpenClaw-controlled registry, pin its digest in the harness, and document its provenance.

options.title: Build the base in controlled CI
options.body: Have the workflow build the small checked-in base before running the E2E image, trading some CI time for fully repository-auditable provenance.

options.title: Accept the external publisher boundary
options.body: Keep the pinned Docker Hub dependency only after maintainers explicitly accept its ownership, availability, and rebuild-provenance tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Publish an OpenClaw-controlled base image
recommendation.body: Build and publish the base from the checked-in Dockerfile under an OpenClaw-controlled registry, pin its digest in the harness, and document its provenance.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current harness implementation and can adapt it once the repository chooses the image-provenance model.
